/metanoia-wiki/rules/character-creation/.title: Character Creation
/metanoia-wiki/rules/character-creation/.summary: It's assumed player characters start at Realm 1 unless otherwise stated.

/metanoia-wiki/rules/character-creation/.title: Awakening & Experiences
/metanoia-wiki/rules/character-creation/.summary: Sensing Ren is involuntary. Pursuing it is a choice, and rarely an easy one. Roll a d12.

/metanoia-wiki/rules/character-creation/.title: Building the Sheet
/metanoia-wiki/rules/character-creation/.summary: Work through these in order. Each part of a character is defined in full on the Character Creation page; this page has the rolls and choices.

/metanoia-wiki/rules/character-creation/.title: Friends, Faction & Missions
/metanoia-wiki/rules/character-creation/.summary: If you have no siblings, roll a second friend: someone you grew up with. Write a Childhood Experience about them in place of the Sibling Experience (see Sibling Count).

/metanoia-wiki/rules/character-creation/.summary: Where you grew up, your Ren's Texture, and the people who raised you.

/metanoia-wiki/rules/equipment/.title: Equipment, Armor & Currency
/metanoia-wiki/rules/equipment/.summary: Items unlock or enhance keywords. How an item adds to a roll is covered under Items in Core Resolution.

/metanoia-wiki/rules/favor/.title: Favor

/metanoia-wiki/rules/injuries-strain-res.title: Injuries, Strain & Rest
/metanoia-wiki/rules/injuries-strain-res.summary: Every Character has a number of strain they can take before passing out. Characters accumulate strain (get more tired), and remove strain during rest.

/metanoia-wiki/rules/keywords/.title: Keywords
/metanoia-wiki/rules/keywords/.summary: Pre-Defined language has meaning within the system and can't be overwritten. Un-Defined meas that it's up to the players and the GM to determine what the language means in the rules.

/metanoia-wiki/rules/realm-advancement/.title: Realm Advancement
/metanoia-wiki/rules/realm-advancement/.summary: To advance in Realm, one needs to find suitable resources one Realm higher than their current Realm.

/metanoia-wiki/rules/resolution/.title: Core Resolution

/metanoia-wiki/rules/time-and-scale/.title: Time & Scale
/metanoia-wiki/rules/time-and-scale/.summary: These can happen in any order. You can move, act, then stop. You can act first and then reposition. You can split movement before and after your resolution if the situation allows it.

/metanoia-wiki/sheet/privacy/.title: Privacy
